I like the game a lot, it has a fair to wide variety of dragons/weapons you may choose from. Each dragon/weapons has its own unique attacks, however, I will complain that I don't feel certain dragons/weapons are balanced out in a fair way. The game has 4 different maps, and a voting system for which map you would like next after a 25-30 minutes time period. Some maps seems to be a bit laggy, and the servers are down (for multiplayer) sometimes, which can be frustrating, but it's a pleasure to play versus your friends, rivals, and even enemies. Runes also make this game interesting, allowing your dragon to gain small buffs that overall make a huge impact the more you level up in battle. This adds a nice complexity to the game, allowing you to easily twist and turn past a few of your dragon's/weapon's weaknesses, or to allow you to try and make it slightly less of a weakness. The rating system is a nice feature, making so you don't play against newer players, adding challenge, but also making it so that they don't get creamed and can learn a few steps at a time of how the game works. 

While the game is no longer in developement, I think it'd be nice if it was. 

One last thing, it would be nice to have a way to gain more crystals (the currency in the game) other than buying the titan pass, which gives you 4x crystals, but only for 1 year. I think making it so you can gain crystals in a faster manner (with either the titan pass's 4x crystals no longer working or if you can't/haven't gotten the titan pass). I've heard complaints about not getting very many crystals after a match, making it so you must grind (which is very annoying) Singleplayer or Multiplayer. With the game no longer in developement and the fact it has "died" a quite a bit, people think the $25 for the titan pass is no longer worth it.

I do really enjoy this game though, and I myself don't want to give up on it. Hope the devs decide to go back to it and give it a little more love  <3
